name: Nojima Satomi
source:
She is 38 years old and is the president of the parents' association at Kouta's school. She gives off the impression of being a stubborn and educated mother. Her personality is strict but is generally a kind woman.

Her only son is a classmate of Kouta's. She seems to be enjoying the activities of the "Mom's Club.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
